caption: A vibrant bowl of ramen sits on a dark wooden table. Golden broth, tender pork, and fresh ingredients create a rich, aromatic scene.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain and warm undertones
Golden seared chashu pork, tender and slightly crispy on edges
Dark green nori seaweed, thin and crisp with slight wave-like folds
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth golden and clear with faint foam
Golden menma bamboo shoots, slender and slightly translucent with a bumpy texture
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, slightly textured surface and rounded edges
Swirled naruto fish cake, soft and marbled with a smooth, slightly chewy surface
